name: Far Step

source.note: Entered from knowledge of Xanathar's Guide to Everything, a 2014-rules spell the owner added on 2026-10-15; no 2024 book reprints it. Check every number against the owner's copy.

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet

summary: Bonus Action: teleport up to 60 ft to a space you can see, and again with a Bonus Action on each of your turns while you concentrate.
text: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. For as long as you concentrate on the spell, you can use a Bonus Action on each of your turns to teleport in the same way again.

sustain.label: Far Step
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.
